properties.name: card_layout
properties.comment: The padding, section gap and header and footer extents; a view. Until written the card follows its theme's layout (effective_card_layout); a write overrides it, and reset_card_layout_to_theme returns to the theme's. Values that are not finite or are unbounded throw std::invalid_argument.
hand: a view onto layout_ beside uses_theme_layout_; write_view validates and leaves the theme's layout

properties.name: interactive
properties.comment: Whether the card takes focus, the pointer and activation. Turning it off clears the hot, pressed and focused visuals.
hand: written sets focusability and clears the interaction visuals

properties.name: selected
properties.comment: Whether the card is selected; a change raises selected_changed. selection_behavior decides whether activation writes it.

properties.name: selection_behavior
properties.comment: Whether activation only notifies (manual, the default) or also selects or toggles the card before activated is raised. An undeclared value throws std::invalid_argument.
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("card selection behavior is invalid");

not_properties.name: header
not_properties.reason: child slots returning the detached predecessor (G10)
